name: C2-Faith
description: C2-Faith is a benchmark targeting the evaluation of large language model judges on chain-of-thought reasoning faithfulness, focusing on causality and coverage dimensions. It uses controlled perturbations to create examples with known causal errors and coverage deletions, assessing judges on binary causal detection, causal step localization, and coverage scoring.
reputation: A recent, specialized benchmark from the research literature that is gaining attention for evaluating LLM judge faithfulness, but it is not yet a widely established community standard.
notes: Built from PRM800K dataset; evaluates causality and coverage faithfulness in chain-of-thought reasoning; reveals gaps in error detection and localization by LLM judges.
